items.stem:

"My brush is a trowel, my paint is the seed, / My canvas is soil, dark and deep; / I sketch with the rain and I shade with the sun, / And wait for the picture while the seasons run."

(i) What does the speaker use as a "brush"?  (a) A pencil  (b) A trowel  (c) A rake  (d) A leaf
(ii) What is the "canvas" in these lines?  (a) The wall  (b) The sky  (c) The soil  (d) The flower pot

items.answer: (i) (b) A trowel (ii) (c) The soil (iii) Plants take time and seasons to grow and bloom. (iv) Sunlight helps colour and shape the garden, just as shading does in painting.
